title: Inverse-image compatibility of prescribed normalized Cech comparisons
statement: Let $R,S$ be commutative rings, $X,Y$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g:Y\to X$, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ and $f^{\prime}:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}S$. Let $U,V$ be open covers indexed by the same set $I$, with $V_{i_0\ldots i_k}\subseteq g^{-1}U_{i_0\ldots i_k}$ for every nonempty tuple. Let $M,N$ be arbitrary module sheaves, not necessarily quasi-coherent, and $\varphi:M\to g_*N$. For every pair of normalized additive comparison systems $c,c^{\prime}$ [def-pc-cech-comparison-system], for every degree $q$ and cycles $z,z^{\prime}$ in the scalar-restricted Cech complexes [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change] whose coordinates match via $\varphi$ and restriction, $c^{\prime}_{f^{\prime}}([z^{\prime}])=H(\operatorname{coeff}(g,\varphi))(H(\operatorname{invImage}g,\operatorname{constIso}(g)^{-1})(c_f([z])))$, with Ext maps as in [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. No affine-intersection, quasi-coherence, scalar compatibility or bijectivity assertion is included.

source.place: Lemma 20.15.1, augmented pentagon and global-section squares; uniqueness of normalized comparisons by relative Cech effacement

proof.text: Transport scalar-restricted cycles through mapCyclesIso and the categorical-to-explicit Čech chain isomorphism. Prove that their inclusions give exactly cechCoordinate and that the homology projection gives cechOverHomologyAddEquiv, using the canonical mapCyclesIso/mapHomologyIso square and homologyπ naturality.

Form the explicit abelian Čech chain map A of the underlying module coefficient map. The coordinate hypothesis and monicity of the cycle inclusion identify its image cycle with the transported target cycle. Homologyπ naturality identifies the resulting classes.

Factor the underlying coefficient map through the inverse-image adjunction unit and coeff. Prove by restriction naturality that A is the unit Čech chain map B followed by the Čech coefficient chain map.

Apply normalized comparison naturality for the inverse-image unit to B and naturality of the supplied target comparison to coeff. Combine chain-map factorization, functoriality of homology, and the class equality to conclude the unchanged statement.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 20.15.1: separate the unit case from coefficient naturality; scalar transport and cycle-class argument fully formalized by Y3.

theorem cechComparison_inverseImage_compatibility
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
    (g : Y ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (f' : Y ⟶ Spec (.of S))
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (hcover' : iSup V = ⊤) (M : X.Modules) (N : Y.Modules)
    (φ : M ⟶ (pushforward g).obj N)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (c : CechComparisonSystem U hcover) (c' : CechComparisonSystem V hcover') :
    ∀ (q : ℕ) (z : (cechOver f U M).cycles q) (z' : (cechOver f' V N).cycles q),
      (∀ y : Fin (q + 1) → ι,
        cechCoordinate f' V N q y ((cechOver f' V N).iCycles q z') =
          N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hinter q y)).op
            (φ.val.app (op (⨅ l, U (y l)))
              (cechCoordinate f U M q y ((cechOver f U M).iCycles q z)))) →
      c'.overMap f' N q ((cechOver f' V N).homologyπ q z') =
        Sheaf.H.map (coeff g φ) q
          (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage g) (constIso g).symm
            ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj M) q
              (c.overMap f M q ((cechOver f U M).homologyπ q z)))
